CustomField.inlineHelpText: Discount as a proportion of list, computed rather than summed. On an aggregate row this is that row own discount divided by its own list amount - never the sum or the average of the child percentages, which is how a 60% discount on $1,000 and a 10% discount on $100,000 would print as 70% or 35% instead of about 10.5%. Blank when the list amount is zero.
CustomField.label: Effective Discount %
